summary: LLM synthesis helper for @translator's LLM mode
prompt: Implement agents/llm_synth.py for the StranglerRoom project (Python 3.12, stdlib only plus the project's own modules). It is @translator's LLM synthesis mode (docs/AGENTS_SPEC.md section 2, 'LLM mode'). The binding API is the docstring of tests/test_llm_synth.py; every test there must pass; tests/fake_llm.py is the fake STRANGLER_LLM_CMD the tests use. Requirements: (1) DEFAULT_LLM_CMD = "claude -p --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --output-format text". (2) class SynthesisError(RuntimeError) for every failure, str() is a one-line human-readable reason. (3) build_prompt(legacy_source: str, policy: dict) -> str: read docs/SPEC.md relative to the repo root (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'docs/SPEC.md'), include verbatim the text from the line starting '## 2.' up to (excluding) the line starting '## 4.'; raise SynthesisError if the file or the headings are missing. The prompt explains the task (port the legacy web.py lists plugin to a FastAPI APIRouter module for targets/modern_fastapi/app/lists.py; per quirk tag 'preserve' = reproduce legacy exactly, 'deprecate' or absent = textbook FastAPI v1 behaviour from SPEC section 3; everything else byte-identical JSON to legacy; use `from targets.modern_fastapi.app.store import STORE` for data; only stdlib + fastapi + pydantic imports; define module-level `router = APIRouter()`; no app object; answer with exactly ONE ```python fenced block containing the whole module), then the legacy source inside a ```python fence, and the policy as json.dumps(policy, indent=2, sort_keys=True) inside the FIRST ```json fence of the prompt (no other ```json fence may precede it; the SPEC excerpt contains none). Make sure the literal string '## 4. Modern target' never appears in the prompt. (4) extract_module(answer) -> str: first fence whose info string is python or py (case-insensitive), else first bare ``` fence; body stripped of trailing whitespace/newlines and returned with exactly one trailing '\n'; SynthesisError mentioning 'no fenced python code block' when absent or empty. Fences: an opening line ``` + optional info string, closing line ``` alone; tolerate \r\n. (5) validate_module(source) -> list[str]: ast.parse (on SyntaxError return ['syntax error: <msg> (line N)'] and stop); check a module-level binding named router (Assign / AnnAssign / AugAssign targets incl. tuple unpacking, or import ... as router / from x import router); if missing add "module defines no top-level 'router'"; then compile(source, '<llm-synthesised lists.py>', 'exec') and on failure add 'compile error: <msg>'. Never exec the module. (6) synthesize(legacy_source, policy, *, cmd=None, timeout=300) -> str: command = cmd or os.environ.get('STRANGLER_LLM_CMD') or DEFAULT_LLM_CMD, split with shlex.split, run with subprocess.run(argv, input=prompt, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout) without a shell; FileNotFoundError/PermissionError -> SynthesisError('LLM command not found: ...'); TimeoutExpired -> SynthesisError('LLM command timed out after <timeout>s'); non-zero returncode -> SynthesisError(f'LLM command exited with status {rc}: <last 300 chars of stderr, single line>'); then extract_module and validate_module, any problems -> SynthesisError('LLM module rejected: ' + '; '.join(problems)). Return the module source. Module docstring documents the whole flow; type hints; no print(). Answer with the single file.
